en.t: I waited in something close to despair.

units.source_text: 这早春的天空保闪亮的玻璃窗，不让人窥见其内部，但我相信其内部隐藏着火和破灭。

en.t: This early spring sky kept its shining glass windows closed, allowing no one to peer inside, yet I believed that fire and ruin were hidden within it.

units.source_text: 如前所述，我对人的关心是淡薄的。

en.t: As I said before, my interest in other people was faint.

units.source_text: 父亲的死，母亲的贫穷，几乎没能左右我的内心生活。

en.t: My father's death and my mother's poverty had scarcely any power to sway my inner life.

units.source_text: 我只幻想着一种在巨大的天下的压榨机似的东西，

en.t: I merely imagined something like a vast press beneath the heavens,

units.source_text: 在一定的条件下把灾难、悲惨的结局、灭绝人往的悲剧、

en.t: which, under certain conditions, would crush disasters, miserable endings, tragedies that extinguish human lives,

units.source_text: 人、物质、丑陋的东西、美好的东西，统统压得粉碎。

en.t: people, matter, ugly things, and beautiful things alike into powder.

units.source_text: 早春的天空异乎寻常的璀璨，令人常常以为是覆盖着大地的巨斧的冰凉的刃光。

en.t: The early spring sky glittered with an extraordinary brilliance, often making one think it was the cold gleam of the blade of a huge axe covering the earth.

units.source_text: 我只是等待着它的下落，甚至无暇思索就迅速下落。

en.t: I only waited for it to fall, to fall so swiftly that there would not even be time to think.
